issue.title: Login says "validation failed" when the email has a trailing space
issue.body:
On iPhones, picking the email address from the keyboard's suggestion bar adds a
space after it. The login request then comes back with

    400 {"error":"validation failed","details":{"email":["Invalid email"]}}

instead of signing in, and our sales team thinks their accounts are broken.
Typing the same address by hand works. The "Forgot password" form does the
same with the suggested address.

input.title: Trim whitespace from email before validating at login and password reset
input.body:
File: src/api/auth.ts

The loginSchema and resetRequestSchema validate email with z.string().email() without trimming, so an address with a trailing space (added by the iPhone keyboard suggestion bar) fails validation with "Invalid email". Add .trim() before .email() in both schemas (z.string().trim().email()) so the surrounding whitespace is removed before the address is checked and looked up. Typed addresses are unaffected.
